desc: As a testament to the extraordinary accomplishments of Scouting’s highest achievers, and in reverence to a legacy spanning more than a century, Henry Repeating Arms is proud to offer this Centennial Tribute Edition rifle honoring America’s Eagle Scouts. Built on the world-renowned Big Boy platform, this special edition commemorates both the Eagle Scout rank and its enduring impact through Scouting America. At the heart of the rifle is its iconic hardened brass receiver, where the Eagle Scout Award Medal is engraved on the right side and selectively nickel plated for striking contrast. An American-style scroll pattern surrounds the medal and continues forward past the side loading gate. Adjacent to the medal, a scrolling banner reads Scouting America. The left side of the receiver is adorned with a highly detailed portrait of a majestic bald eagle, also selectively plated in nickel. Intertwined with the scrollwork is a banner bearing the pledge, “To This I Pledge My Sacred Honor,” the closing line recited at every Eagle Court of Honor and a powerful reminder of both achievement earned and responsibility accepted.
